content: Hello, this is Janet from Eastside Medical Billing. I'm here to help with any questions about your recent hospital statement or payment confirmation. How can I assist you today?
Hi Janet, I just paid my invoice for the April surgery yesterday via PayPal. I want to make sure everything went through so there's no hold on my account.
Thanks for letting me know! Could you please confirm if you used the PayPal handle 'eastside.billing@hospital.org' as the recipient? Our records usually update within 24 hours if that's the case.
Yes, that's the email I sent it to. The payment was for $1,650, and my patient account number is 0215497. I used the reference 'S. Patel 4/11/24'.

Great, S. Patel, account 0215497, $1,650 via PayPal to 'eastside.billing@hospital.org', that matches our protocol perfectly. The reference helps us track your payment quickly. You should get a digital receipt emailed to s.patel78@gmail.com by noon tomorrow.
Perfect. Is there anything else I need to do to avoid late fees? The bill said payment needed to be in by the 12th.

You're all set, as long as the transaction ID from PayPal, usually a 17-digit alphanumeric code, shows up in our system by midnight tonight. If you don't see the confirmation email by tomorrow, let us know with that ID handy for instant verification.
Will do. PayPal sent me confirmation ID 5YH13794NA382461 to my email.

That's perfect, thank you for sharing the confirmation ID. Your payment is officially logged under your account, and there will be no late fees. For your records, keep this email thread and the PayPal receipt. Let me know if any further issues arise!
